claim: On 2024-11-6 the Amazon MSK guide added the Express broker feature: MSK supports Standard and new Express brokers.
question: When were Express brokers added to Amazon MSK?

values.display: MSK supports Standard and new Express brokers

note: The change feed dates the general availability of Express brokers to 2024-11-07 (the What's New page is blocked by robots.txt). Older exam questions know only the Standard broker type. Current truth: msk-express-up-to-3x-throughput-20x-faster-scaling.
